segments.headline: Does this task need an AI agent?
segments.body: The expensive mistake starts before the first prompt.
segments.spoken: A vendor offers an AI agent for every invoice. But does your business need an agent, or a reliable rule?

segments.headline: Predictable task? Start with rules.
segments.body: Known inputs. Testable decision. Clear exception path.
segments.spoken: When inputs and decisions follow known rules, use ordinary automation. Test the rule, log the outcome, and route exceptions.

segments.headline: Separate routine work from ambiguity.
segments.body: Use AI assistance only where context matters.
segments.spoken: When documents are ambiguous, AI helps extract context or prepare a draft. Keep uncertain cases separate from routine work.

segments.headline: AI drafts. People approve.
segments.body: A human approval gate lives outside the model.
segments.spoken: Give the AI read and draft access. Let a person approve sensitive changes before the authorized system acts.

segments.headline: Reading invoices is not paying invoices.
segments.body: Keep payment credentials outside the model.
segments.spoken: Never give a language model payment credentials simply because it reads invoices. A prompt is not an approval control.

segments.headline: Measure the full operating cost.
segments.body: Compare verified outcomes, not demo speed.
segments.spoken: Compare cost per accepted result, correction rate, and oversight time. Fast output is not valuable when errors increase.

segments.headline: Choose the least complex safe system.
segments.body: PrismBay AI helps operators implement practical AI business systems.
segments.spoken: Use rules for predictable work, AI for ambiguous work, and human authority for consequential decisions. Subscribe to PrismBay AI.
